caption_L1: This is a bar chart called Average monthly rainfall deviation in the United Kingdom (UK) from 2015 to 2020 (in millimeters). The y-axis plots Month as categorical scale from Apr to Sep while the x-axis shows 2017 as categorical scale from −80 to 40.
caption_L2L3: This graph provides information on the deviations each month can have from the average rainfall overall that the UK recieves, It shows clearly that in the months of january, rainfall continously underperformed and rained generally less than the usual, much less than the expected rainfall of other months. It also shows that the rainfall during the months of february and june exceeded expectations frequently.
